'''Prison Planet''' is a controversial news and opinion website known for its focus on conspiracy theories and alternative viewpoints. It is closely associated with [[Alex Jones]] and [[Paul Joseph Watson]]. 

Prison Planet has been at the center of numerous controversies over its promotion of conspiracy theories, particularly those related to government surveillance, the [[New World Order]], false flag operations, and other fringe beliefs. Critics have frequently accused the site of disseminating misinformation and fostering a climate of distrust in mainstream media and governmental institutions.

Prison Planet often features contributions from writers and commentators who share its alternative perspectives on global events. Its connection to Alex Jones further amplifies its notoriety, as Jones himself has been a highly polarizing figure due to his incendiary rhetoric and frequent brushes with controversy, including legal battles over his statements on significant events such as the [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]].

Prison Planet serves as a prominent example of the growing influence of alternative media platforms in shaping public discourse, particularly among audiences that question conventional viewpoints and seek alternative explanations for world events.
